briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny shape deployment strategies worldwide.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced multi-step reasoning; Anthropic's Claude 4.1 focuses on constitutional AI improvements while Meta open-sourced Llama 4.2.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins next month.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships H200 Blackwell clusters to xAI and Microsoft; TSMC reports record AI chip demand with 3nm capacity fully booked through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs before 2027?
